name: github-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration for GitHub repository tools. Empowers AI coding agents to automate pull request creation and code review, triage issues, and monitor CI/CD GitHub Actions workflow execution.

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained) with 'repo' and 'workflow' scopes.

GITHUB_OWNER.description: Default GitHub organization or user handle owning the target repository.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in the repository from a feature branch into the base branch.

title.description: Pull request title adhering to Conventional Commits (e.g., 'feat: add Pass 4 MCP server configuration hub').

head.description: The name of the branch where your changes are implemented.

base.description: The name of the branch you want the changes pulled into.

body.description: Detailed markdown body of the pull request detailing context, changes, and verification evidence.

draft.description: Whether to create the pull request as an in-progress draft.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a pull request, including state, mergeability, CI status checks, and author.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in the repository filtered by state, base, head, or sort direction.

tools.name: create_pull_request_review
tools.description: Submit a formal code review on a pull request with comments and an event decision (APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, COMMENT).

comments.description: Optional list of line-specific review comments (path, position, body).

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in the GitHub repository with title, markdown body, labels, and assignees.

body.description: Detailed description of the issue or bug.

assignees.description: List of GitHub usernames to assign.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Retrieve details and metadata of an issue by its issue number.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues for the repository with filters by state, labels, milestone, and sort criteria.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue's title, body description, state (open/closed), or labels.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow runs filtered by workflow file, branch, or execution status.

workflow_id.description: Workflow file name (e.g., 'ci.yml', 'deploy.yml') or integer ID.

branch.description: Filter runs by Git branch name.

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.description: Inspect execution status, conclusion (success/failure/cancelled), duration, and jobs of a GitHub Actions run.

run_id.description: The unique GitHub Actions workflow run ID.

tools.name: get_workflow_run_logs
tools.description: Retrieve step execution logs and failure output for a workflow run to diagnose CI/CD build failures.

security.notes: Use GitHub fine-grained Personal Access Tokens scoped exclusively to this repository. Never grant admin or delete privileges to autonomous agent credentials.
